effect_on_the_baseline: the continuity row's compact and clear gaps are now explained by the host surface rather than left unexamined: compaction exists as a human command this adapter's one-shot surface cannot drive, and clearing has no command to execute at all.

clear_has_no_command_package.observation: the packages whose names mention commands are dsh-client-ui-commands, dsh-command-compact, dsh-command-feedback, dsh-command-goal, dsh-commands, dsh-native-command, dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm and dsh-system-prompt - there is no dsh-command-clear
clear_has_no_command_package.reading: nothing in this build registers a `/clear` command; the practical meaning of clearing is starting a fresh conversation, which is the `new` case already measured end to end
clear_has_no_command_package.trace: the only mention found is in dsh-agent/README.md, which does not register a command

compact_is_a_command_plugin.reading: compaction is offered to a person inside a session, as a command. It is not a session controller RPC, which is why the two argument shapes tried earlier answered 404, and why the one-shot headless runner - which does not compose the command layer - treats it as prompt text.
compact_is_a_command_plugin.shipped_comment: Human `/compact`: one useful reduction below the automatic threshold. Backend independent, so it follows whichever compaction service this leaf mounts.
